edges: Flaherty praises Christy for his boldness.
Many women, including the Widow Quin, become attracted to Christy.
Christy impresses the village women by his victory in a donkey race.
Christy's father tracks him to the tavern.
When the townsfolk realize that Christy's father is alive, everyone, including Pegeen, shuns him.
Christy apologizes to his father and embraces him.
The townspeople, led by Pegeen, bind and prepare to hang Christy.
Christy's life is saved when his father crawls back onto the scene.
Pegeen laments betraying and losing Christy.
Flaherty praises Christy for his boldness.
Christy claims he killed his own father.
Widow Quin tries to seduce Christy at Shawn's behest.
Christy impresses the village women by his victory in a donkey race.
Christy's father tracks him to the tavern.
Townsfolk realize that Christy's father is alive and shun him as a liar and a coward.
Christy attacks his father a second time.
Townspeople, led by Pegeen, bind and prepare to hang Christy.
Christy's life is saved when his father crawls back onto the scene.
Pegeen laments betraying and losing Christy.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Shawn suggests he and Pegeen get married soon, but she spurns him.
